decisions.reason: Placing the INA219 downstream of the Schottky diodes does not change DCDC1's voltage, current rating, or normal-operation role.
The main-board architecture already assigns 3.3V current monitoring to the main board; the detailed INA219 topology belongs to the monitoring Requirement and does not change the board-role state.
The INA219 measurement placement does not change the standalone LDO, activation condition, powered rail, loads, source-selection rule, or purpose.
The downstream INA219 topology does not alter the AXP2101 selection, battery power path, or required system rails.
The source decision concerns INA219 placement and coverage on the 3.3V rail and does not change the independently switched 5V rail.

The same source message already records the interboard chain, connectors, and forwarding behavior under this Requirement; the additional INA219 placement detail is owned by the current-monitoring Requirement and requires no interface-state change.
The 3.3V INA219 topology does not change the LED supply choice, level shifting, 5V shutdown control, or standby-current target.
Measuring the ESP32 as part of total downstream 3.3V current does not change its clock, sleep, deep-sleep, or wake behavior.
The INA219 location and measurement coverage do not affect the battery connector's type, contacts, accessibility, compatibility, or unresolved pin order.
The current-monitoring topology does not modify battery overcharge, overdischarge, thermal sensing, or protection requirements.
The 3.3V current-monitor placement does not change the charge-status LED path, connector, resistor, or population requirements.
The INA219 power-path decision does not change the panel reset connector, location, or EN-to-GND action.
